questions.question: Dr. Mourad, a recent graduate, is about to open his practice. According to Article 2 of the Code of Ethics, what is his primary mission toward the human person?
options: Respect the life of the human person in the exercise of his mission
Expand his clientele by any means
questions.explanation: Article 2 states that the dental surgeon exercises his mission with respect for the life of the human person.

questions.question: Dr. Manal, an experienced dentist, reminds Dr. Mourad that according to Article 3, he must refrain from any act likely to discredit his profession. Does this mean he can practice another activity in parallel?
options: Yes, if it is a lucrative activity
Yes, if it is not incompatible with his professional dignity
No, no other activity is authorized
Yes, if he informs the Order council
questions.explanation: Article 3 prohibits the dentist from practicing another activity incompatible with his professional dignity, but allows compatible activities.

questions.question: Dr. Mourad wishes to use patient data for a scientific publication. According to Article 4, what is his main obligation?
options: Obtain written authorization from the patient
questions.explanation: Article 4 specifies that the dentist must ensure that patient identification is impossible when using medical observations for scientific publications.

questions.question: According to Article 4, Dr. Manal must ensure that the people assisting her are instructed of their obligation regarding professional secrecy. Who is concerned by this obligation?
questions.explanation: Article 4 specifies that the dentist must ensure that persons assisting him/her are instructed of their obligation regarding professional secrecy and comply with it.

questions.question: Dr. Mourad is wondering about advertising for his new practice. According to Article 11, what is the rule regarding advertising?
options: Advertising is permitted on social media
Advertising is permitted with the Order's approval
questions.explanation: Article 11 prohibits all direct or indirect advertising or publicity methods, as well as spectacular events that do not have an exclusively scientific or educational purpose.

questions.question: Dr. Manal explains to Dr. Mourad that according to Article 13, professional nameplates have regulated dimensions. What are they?
questions.explanation: Article 13 sets the dimensions of professional nameplates at 25 centimeters by 30 centimeters.

questions.question: According to Article 13, what information is authorized on a professional nameplate?
options: Only the name and title of the dentist
Name, first name, title, specialty, days and hours of consultation
questions.explanation: Article 13 authorizes the name, first name, title, specialty, origin of the diploma, days and hours of consultation, floor number, telephone number, and recognized titles.

questions.question: According to Article 14, must Dr. Mourad submit announcements regarding the opening of his practice to the prior approval of the Superior Council of the Order?
questions.explanation: Article 14 states that announcements concerning the opening, closing, or transfer of a practice must be submitted to the prior approval of the Superior Council of the Order.

questions.question: Dr. Manal warns Dr. Mourad about rebates. According to Article 16, what is the rule regarding rebates to patients?
options: Rebates are allowed for loyal patients
Rebates are allowed with Order approval
Rebates are allowed for large families
questions.explanation: Article 16 prohibits any rebate in money or in kind given to a patient, as well as any payment, acceptance, or sharing of money between practitioners.

questions.question: According to Article 16, what is dichotomie (fee-splitting) in the dental profession?
options: A prohibited sharing of money between practitioners
questions.explanation: Article 16 prohibits any sharing of money between practitioners or between practitioners and other persons (fee-splitting).

questions.question: Dr. Mourad wishes to partner with a colleague. According to Article 18, what is 'compérage' (collusion) and why is it prohibited?
options: A secret understanding aimed at harming another person
questions.explanation: Article 18 defines collusion as a secret understanding between two persons aimed at harming another, and formally prohibits it.

questions.question: According to Article 6, what are the traditional principles of dental practice?
options: Free choice of dentist, freedom of prescriptions, direct agreement on fees
questions.explanation: Article 6 lists the principles: free choice of dentist, freedom of prescriptions, direct agreement between patient and dentist regarding fees, and direct payment of fees.

questions.question: Dr. Manal explains to Dr. Mourad that according to Article 7, he must treat all his patients:
options: With the same conscience, regardless of their status, nationality, religion
questions.explanation: Article 7 requires the dentist to treat all patients with the same conscience, regardless of their status, nationality, religion, reputation, or the feelings they inspire.

questions.question: According to Article 9, is a dentist permitted to issue a certificate of complaisance?
options: Yes, if the patient requests it
Yes, if it is for a relative
questions.explanation: Article 9 prohibits the establishment of a biased report or the issuance of a certificate of complaisance.

questions.question: According to Article 11, can Dr. Mourad practice his profession in a commercial storefront?
options: Yes, if the store is closed
questions.explanation: Article 11 prohibits the practice of dentistry in a storefront or any premises where commercial activity is carried out.

questions.question: Dr. Manal reminds Dr. Mourad that according to Article 12, what information is authorized on professional cards?
options: Names, first names, address, phone, days and hours of consultations
questions.explanation: Article 12 authorizes on professional printed materials: names, first names, address, telephone numbers, fax numbers, days and hours of consultations, recognized titles valid by the National Council of the Order, and recognized honorary distinctions.

questions.question: According to Article 15, the usurpation of titles by a dentist is:
questions.explanation: Article 15 prohibits the usurpation of titles, the use of false titles, as well as all methods intended to deceive the public about the value of the titles indicated.

questions.question: Dr. Mourad is wondering about fee payment. According to Article 6, what is the principle?
options: Direct payment of fees by the patient to the dentist
questions.explanation: Article 6 provides for direct payment of fees by the patient to the dentist as a fundamental principle.

questions.question: According to Article 30, must Dr. Mourad provide explanations about his fees to a patient who asks?
options: Yes, but only if the patient has insurance
No, patients must accept rates without discussion
questions.explanation: Article 30 specifies that the dentist is never entitled to refuse a patient explanations regarding the amount of his fees.

questions.question: According to Article 30, in what case may Dr. Manal request a deposit?
options: When the importance of the treatment justifies it
questions.explanation: Article 30 authorizes the dentist to request a deposit when the importance of the treatment justifies it, in accordance with professional customs.

questions.question: According to Article 30, when Dr. Mourad proposes high-cost treatment, what is his obligation?
options: Establish a written estimate to give to the patient
Refuse treatment if the patient cannot pay
questions.explanation: Article 30 requires the dentist to establish a written estimate when led to propose high-cost treatment.

questions.question: According to Article 35, can Dr. Manal lower her fees for competitive purposes?
options: No, she must not lower her fees for competitive purposes
questions.explanation: Article 35 prohibits the dentist from lowering his fees for competitive purposes, below the customary scales.

questions.question: According to Article 24, what are Dr. Mourad's obligations toward his patients?
options: Provide fast care without worrying about quality
Provide informed care in accordance with established scientific knowledge
questions.explanation: Article 24 requires the dentist to provide informed care in accordance with established scientific knowledge, and to always act with courtesy toward the patient.

questions.question: According to Article 25, can Dr. Manal withdraw from her mission with a patient?
options: Yes, at any time without justification
Yes, provided she never harms the patient and ensures continuity of care
No, she must follow all her patients to the end
Yes, if the patient does not pay
questions.explanation: Article 25 allows the dentist to withdraw from his mission provided he never harms the patient and ensures continuity of care.

questions.question: According to Article 48, how should Dr. Mourad handle a professional disagreement with a colleague?
options: First attempt reconciliation, then notify the President of the National Council
questions.explanation: Article 48 requires the dentist to first attempt reconciliation with his colleague, and if unsuccessful, to notify the President of the National Council of the Order for conciliation.

questions.question: According to Article 51, can Dr. Manal divert a colleague's clientele?
options: Yes, if the colleague is less competent
Yes, if she offers lower rates
questions.explanation: Article 51 formally prohibits the diversion or attempted diversion of clientele.
